Having grown up in a household where my parents only finished primary school, I always felt that school was the place to discover it. I loved the logic and structure. My experience with AI in this area is limited to general curiosity.",
    "How would you explain, step by step, how to solve a second order algebraic equation?": "First, you write the equation in standard form. Then, you identify the coefficients.
